title: Repo waivers (.a2dlc/waivers.json, versioned)
description: The agent declares a deliberate behavior change here. Declaring is not approving: the approval is a signature in .a2dlc/approvals.json (ADR meta/0004). A waiver without a valid signature lets check pass and blocks verify.

decision.description: On an engine target: enforce_new_behavior | preserve_legacy. On a test (<test file>::<id>): characterization_test (the test passes on the base on purpose) | quarantine_flaky (quarantine: does not count for PASS or FAIL). On a finding of a pluggable check (<file>::<check id> or <file>::L<line>): accept_finding (the finding is accepted on purpose; the signature binds the file's blob, so it covers this content of the file and not the check's future findings). A decision of the other class does not cover the target.
